question: In December 2022, Meghana Ahlawat was elected as the President of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Table Tennis Federation of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meghana Ahlawat:-**

 
 
• She was elected as the President of Table Tennis Federation of India in December 2022.
 
 
 
• **Table Tennis Federation of India:-**
 
 
• It is the governing body for table tennis in India and is responsible for organizing national and international events, selecting teams for international tournaments, and promoting the sport in the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BCCI:-**

 
 
• Board of Control for Cricket in India is the national governing body for cricket in India and is responsible for organizing domestic and international cricket tournaments, selecting teams for international tournaments, and promoting the sport in the country.
 
 
 
• **Hockey India:-**
 
 
• It is the governing body for field hockey in India and is responsible for organizing national and international events, selecting teams for international tournaments, and promoting the sport in the country.
 
 
 
• **Wrestling Federation of India:-**
 
 
• It is the governing body for wrestling in India and is responsible for organizing national and international events, selecting teams for international tournaments, and promoting the sport in the country.
